options.description: Checks keep running on the previous version's copy until the new one is ready, so no answer is lost. A check that still can't run writes one line to .plumb/session/errors.log, only in projects that use plumb. The requirement is reworded to allow both.
options.label: Old copy + error log (Recommended)

options.description: Checks run only on the copy matching the plugin version. In the window they don't run, but each miss is written to .plumb/session/errors.log, so you can see what went unrecorded. Answers given in the window are still lost.
options.label: Error log only

options.description: Checks that can't run stay silent and nothing new is written into the project. Answers given right after a reinstall are still lost; restarting the session is the cure.
options.label: Keep it as is

payload.question: When the plumb plugin is reinstalled mid-session, plumb's background checks can't run until a private copy for the new version is built, so your answers go unrecorded. What should plumb do in that window?
